Subject: Draft: Annotated topology + threat-model summary for Autonomy Bank (attached)

Hi Glen —

Attached are the initial artifacts for your review:
- redwood-annotated-topology-autonomy-v1.pdf (annotated topology showing Hosted / Dedicated / Private variants, control-plane demarcation, operator VLAN segmentation, and egress paths)
- threat-model-summary-autonomy-v1.md (one-page summary with prioritized attack paths and mitigations)

Highlights (TL;DR):
- Isolation model: tenants are isolated by per-tenant inference sessions with dedicated KV cache namespaces and enforced memory segmentation at the runtime layer; for Dedicated/Private we support pinned GPU pools and network-level microsegmentation.
- KV/cache protection: runtime uses namespace-scoped caches with strong eviction boundaries; cache namespace keys are minted per-requestor identity and not reused across tenants. Access to the KV namespace is instrumented and logged; replay-resistant tokens are used for cache ops.
- Egress controls: default-deny at north-south edges, with explicit per-tenant egress allowlists. Private deployments can use customer-managed NAT and routing; Hosted supports regional egress restrictions and a bastionless operator workflow that funnels operator actions through a constrained control plane with short-lived certificates.
- Operator & audit: RBAC + just-in-time (JIT) access for operators; all operator sessions are recorded and hashed into our immutable telemetry stream (SIEM ingest links included in evidence packet).

Open points we captured while drafting (please confirm):
1) For the Hosted annotated view we included a simplified cache lifecycle flow. If you require a token-level timeline for a sample request, we can add it as an appendix.
2) For Private mode we used placeholder CIDRs in the diagram. If you share your CIDRs we will drop them into the final artifact (or keep placeholders if preferred).

Next steps: we will finalize the evidence packet (logs, operator runbook, KMS attestations) and send by 2026-09-17. Can we lock the deep-dive for Tue 2026-09-14 11:00 AM PT?

Attachments (stubs): redwood-annotated-topology-autonomy-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB), threat-model-summary-autonomy-v1.md (markdown, 1.2KB)

Thanks — happy to walk through any diagram elements on the call.

— Irene Choi
